answer: The strongest sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. A task randomly samples N graders from the credential reef, where each plume of past verified work has bonded collateral, so verdicts aggregate across identities the attacker cannot multiply at will. Creating each fake grader costs a staked deposit plus a long history of honest grading, and any detected collusion burns that stake, so a gale of forged accounts is far more expensive than the value of one rigged verdict.
